description: Designing in the background: picks an approved reference, writes slot copy from the post, places the creator's real photo and official app logos, proofreads, and leaves a draft for review. Memes: pass template "meme" and/or a meme library reference_id (bamf.list_design_references, category meme_template) to make a meme with Claude: only the template picture with the post's captions in its slots, no headline, footer, logo or CTA; needs post_id. mode "custom" (with likeness and style) makes a unique scene inspired by that meme's joke structure instead. Poll bamf.get_design. Never schedules or publishes. Costs credits.

captions.description: Meme only: ordered panel captions used verbatim in the panel slots. Omit to caption from the post text.

instruction.description: Direction for any design, and the feedback a re-run of an existing design needs (8+ characters, e.g. "fewer cards, bigger type"). For a meme: which point the captions make.

likeness.description: Meme only: put the creator's real likeness in the scene, generated from approved likeness photos (never a pasted cutout or avatar).

mode.description: Meme only. template (default): the real template picture with captions. custom: a uniquely made scene inspired by the meme's joke structure (reference_id, or one BAMF picks that fits the post and was not used recently).

post_id.description: Post to design. Provide post_id or source_post_id.

qa.description: Mark as a QA run so the draft stays out of the review queue.

reference_id.description: Approved design reference to match, or a meme library template id (meme designs only).

style.description: Custom meme only: the design style for the scene, e.g. 'pixar 3d', 'claymation', 'film still'.

name: bamf.design_post
